label: Retorsion on definitional truth, checked
meaning: Premise-free and zero-axiom. (a) The unrestricted characterization principle is logically false in every frame: its single instance at the empty description yields an object satisfying it, which is absurd. (b) If both contrary sole-God descriptions are defined and every defined description is satisfied, the satisfier of the second is God, so by the first satisfier's uniqueness clause it is the first satisfier, which is omnibenevolent and not omnibenevolent: the weak principle's contrary instances clash. (c) A one-object frame satisfies each description separately. (d) A one-object frame in which only P1's description is defined satisfies P1 and the weak principle together, so they are jointly consistent. The weak principle is refuted only together with the contrary definition, which the same freedom of stipulation as P1 licenses.
